narrative.overview: Navy navigation frames a light, practical graduation-project workspace. Traditional Chinese copy and restrained blue actions make the next step clear.
keyCharacteristics: Precise time geometry and complete report labels

rules.name: The Action Color Rule
rules.body: Use blue for interaction and purple for completion; do not introduce green as a new brand accent.

dos: Preserve keyboard focus and written status labels.
Check navigation at 900px and content reflow at 600px.
Keep Gantt frozen labels at 450px desktop and 225px mobile; preserve full report date columns and wrapped task titles.
Use actual timestamps for bars, diamonds for equal endpoints and dagger marks for fallback dates.
Keep full filtered-range PNG/SVG exports, adaptive day/week/month/fit scales and native presentation-dialog focus return.
donts: Do not add decorative hover scaling or elevated metric cards.
Do not reintroduce slogans in functional headings.
Do not apply the offline report font stack to the surrounding application UI.
